# Character enrichment sources

These optional, unreviewed annotations were supplied in the character-enrichment

- Make Me a Hanzi dictionary, commit bddc96d41bef78427ed0e034e9f7e31d71fd1b92:

  `notices/`. Source: https://github.com/skishore/makemeahanzi/tree/bddc96d41bef78427ed0e034e9f7e31d71fd1b92
- Hanzi Writer Data 2.0.1: Arphic Public License. Geometry is fetched on demand
  from the version-pinned package, not replaced by standalone components.
  Notice: `notices/STROKE_DATA_ARPHICPL.txt`.
- BabelStone IDS, 2025-06-27 / Unicode 16.0: source comparisons retain their

  an independently established licence for all underlying characters. No full
  BabelStone snapshot is redistributed here. Source: https://www.babelstone.co.uk/CJK/IDS.TXT
- GF 0014-2009: eight bounded textual rule-example annotations only. No PDF,
  font artwork, table artwork or complete standard component inventory is
  redistributed. Source: https://www.unicode.org/irg/docs/n2739-GF0014-2009.pdf

coverage do not establish editorial approval, etymology or verified stroke names.

entries.text: 落也。从糸瞏聲。
A depiction of a bulging jug or vase → *round container*; *boiler*; *can*.
瓦器。所以盛酒𤖅。秦人鼓之以節謌。象形。凡缶之屬皆从缶。
As per 工# (connecting pipe/tube) + 缶 bulging earthenware jug/vase → large, tube-shaped *jug/cistern*. Compare 瓮 and 甕.
瓦也。从缶工聲。
As per 夬# (scoop out) + 缶 bulging earthenware jug/vase → hole scooped into earthenware to create a container. For other meanings, see 欠.
器破也。从缶，決省聲。
𦉥也。从缶幷聲。
受錢器也。从缶后聲。古以瓦，今以竹。
備火，長頸缾也。从缶，熒省聲。

As per 殸# as described in 聲 (percussion instrument) + 缶 bulging earthenware jug/vase → empty container (← which when struck produces the same hollow sound as the 殸 instrument) → *empty*; *run out of*.
器中空也。从缶殸聲。殸，古文磬字。《詩》云：“缾之罄矣。”
虖# roar + 缶 bulging earthenware jug/vase → *crack* in earthenware (through which air or steam whistles in passing).
裂也。从缶虖聲。缶燒善裂也。

壇.explanation: Platform, altar, forum (e.g. 论坛); distinct from a storage jar.
壇.evidenceScope: 2013 appendix row directly checked for classification; lexical equivalence is not a context-free replacement.

罈.explanation: A jar or earthenware container, e.g. 酒罈. The 2013 mainland appendix treats 罈 as a variant of the traditional-column 罎, not as the main traditional form for this sense.
罈.evidenceScope: OpenCC phrase example confirmed; 2013 appendix row lists 罎 in traditional column, 罈 in variant column.

sources.basis: Lexical example explicitly found in OpenCC 1.4.2 STPhrases

entries.text: 器中盡也。从缶𣪠聲。
An abbreviated form# of 嬰 extend about + 缶 bulging earthenware jug/vase → *pot/jar* with a small mouth, long neck, and that bulges in the middle (compare 壼).
缶也。从缶賏聲。
畾 here an abbreviated form# of the earliest form of 雷 thunder + 缶 bulging earthenware jug/vase → *large liquor jar* (originally, one decorated with a thundercloud motif).
As per 雚# as described in 勸 (circular uniformity) + 缶 bulging earthenware jug/vase → wide-mouthed, bulging earthenware jug/vase → *vessel*; *can* → *boiler*.
器也。从缶雚聲。
A depiction of a *net* in which fish or other objects sought are obscured → *network*. Compare 罔. When used as an element in a dual-element character, 网 most often takes the form 罒.
庖犧所結繩以漁。从冂，下象网交文。凡网之屬皆从网。(今經典變隸作䍏。)
The relevant seal inscription form is a net + 亡# (obscure) → objects obscured in a *net* → *cover*; *obscure* (v.); *non-existence*. Compare 网.
干# thick bar + a variant form of 网 net → *long-handled bird-catching net* (compare 禽). *Rare* is a borrowed meaning.
魚罟也。从网瓜聲。《詩》曰：“施罛濊濊。”
罜䍡，魚罟也。从网主聲。
As per 且# (pile) + 罒 net → *net for catching animals* (rabbits in particular), in which the captive animals would be piled.
兔网也。从网且聲。
古# hard; dried out + 罒 net → hard, dried out *net*.
网也。从网古聲。
As per 民# (blind) + 罒 net → *snare* or *trap* to which prey is blind.
釣也。从网民聲。
As per 圭# (neat) + 罒 net → neatly netted prey → *be caught* (in/on) → *hinder*; *disturb*; *obstruct*. Compare 絓.
積柴水中以聚魚也。从网林聲。
奄# cover/conceal + 罒 net → *cover* fish in catching with a net → *catch*.
䍑也。从网奄聲。
卓# (rise above) + 罒 net → fish-catching *basket* (pulled high out of the water). *Wrap* and *cover* are borrowed meanings.
捕魚器也。从网卓聲。

The relevant seal inscription form is 自# (nose) + 辛 needle/cutting tool → criminal marked for life by having his nose cut off (compare 劓) → *crime*; *sin*; *guilt*; *accuse*; *punish*; *mistake*. As the 自 atop 辛 form was uncomfortably similar to the character 皇 (emperor), it was eventually transformed into 罒 atop 非.
捕魚竹网。从网、非。秦以罪爲辠字。
A variant of 罣 hinder, with 卦# replacing 圭. *Ruled line(s)* is a borrowed meaning, influenced by the reticulated pattern of a net.
捕鳥覆車也。从网叕聲。
魚網也。从网或聲。
直# correct + 罒 net → *place/set/put* nets in correct position and *leave as is* → *deal with*; *position* → *every*; *every other* (day/month etc.) (← be positioned at equal intervals).
赦也。从网、直。
覆也。从网音聲。
Variant of 別# (separate flesh from bone in punishment by cutting) + 罒 net → *punishment* involving separation by severing of body parts and/or imprisonment → *penalty*.

As per 者# (pile) + 罒 net → pile of public offices in a large building, likened to a net → (governmental) *office*; *workplace* → *assign*; *record*; *place* (an object) (← functions carried out in workplaces) → *signature* (← name recorded in its proper place).
部署，有所网屬。从网者聲。
罘罳，屏也。从网思聲。
馬# horse + 罒 net → angry noises produced by a netted horse → *insult*; *abuse*; *curse*.
詈也。从网馬聲。

The lower element was originally 卑 (flatten or lower). The addition of 罒 net indicated the spreading/lowering of a net over prey, ending a hunt. *Leave* (off), *stop* and *end* are associated meanings. In the present form, 卑 is replaced by 能 (bear).
遣有辠也。从网、能。言有賢能而入网，而貫遣之。《周禮》曰：“議能之辟。”
An abbreviated form# of 羅 net + 心 heart/emotions → suffer misfortune (likened to being caught in an emotional net) → *distress*; *suffer from* (an illness); *meet with* (a disaster).
心憂也。从网。未詳。古多通用離。
捕鳥网也。从网𤈫聲。
魚网也。从网㓹聲。㓹，籒文銳。
魚网也。从网曾聲。
罬也。从网童聲。
曲梁寡婦之笱。魚所畱也。从网、畱，畱亦聲。
絹# silk + 罒 net → net used for catching birds or trapping animals → *trap an animal* → *bind* (← tie up captured game. Also, *trap* (n.).
維# (net) + 网 net → large *net* → *thin silk*; *line up* (← grid pattern).
以絲罟鳥也。从网从維。古者芒氏初作羅。
罒 net + 熊 bear → *brown bear* (caught by having a long net spread over it; compare 畢). The pronunciation of the character has been influenced by 罷 (lower a net over prey).
如熊，黃白文。从熊，罷省聲。
A depiction of a goat. However, 羊 came to be identified with *sheep*, a supplier of abundant wool and meat. The pronunciation of the character simulates bleating.
祥也。从𦫳，象頭角足尾之形。孔子曰：“牛羊之字以形舉也。”凡羊之屬皆从羊。
羊鳴也。从羊，象聲气上出。與牟同意。
西戎牧羊人也。从人从羊，羊亦聲。南方蠻閩从虫，北方狄从犬，東方貉从豸，西方羌从羊：此六種也。西南僰人、僬僥，从人；蓋在坤地，頗有順理之性。唯東夷从大。大，人也。夷俗仁，仁者壽，有君子不死之國。孔子曰：“道不行，欲之九夷，乘桴浮於海。”有以也。
小羊也。从羊大聲。讀若達。

The present form combines 大 person standing outstretched and 羊 sheep (originally, goat), but neither of these elements can supply the Old Chinese pronunciation of the character. The phonetically close term conveyed by 㒼 (described in 満) suggests that 美, like 㒼, involved the notion "cover the body completely with an animal skin that has its head still attached." The exact provenance of the meanings *beautiful* and *good* is uncertain, as is the identity of the element replaced by 大.
甘也。从羊从大。羊在六畜主給膳也。美與善同意。
久# (long and curved) + 羊 sheep → *lead/direct* sheep along a winding path. Compare 迪 and 逌.
進善也。从羊久聲。文王拘羑里，在湯陰。
牂羊也。从羊分聲。
羊# sheep + 火 fire → *lamb* (← that fits into a round cooking pot for boiling whole; compare 羜).
羊子也。从羊，照省聲。
水長也。从永羊聲。《詩》曰：“江之羕矣。”
As per 殳# (throw) + 羊 sheep → one *ram* flinging itself against another in butting horns → *black ram*.
夏羊牡曰羖。从羊殳聲。
As per 令# (long sequence) + 羊 sheep → *antelope* (← creature with a pair of beautiful, elongated horns; compare 麗).
宁# stand tall/still + 羊 sheep → fattened (compare 猪) *lamb* (kept immobile; compare 羔).
五月生羔也。从羊宁聲。讀若煑。
As per 氐# (press) + 羊 sheep → rams butting horns → *ram*. Compare 觝 and 牴.
牡羊也。从羊氐聲。
羊 sheep + what was originally not 丑# but rather 又 hand/action indicator → *offer* (fine food). *Shame* and *be ashamed* are borrowed meanings via 忸 → *disgrace*.
進獻也。从羊，羊，所進也；从丑，丑亦聲。
騬羊也。从羊夷聲。
輩也。从羊君聲。
As per 君# (group) + 羊 sheep → *flock* of sheep → *group*; *crowd*; *herd*; *swarm*; *mob*; *throng*; *cluster*.
羊名。从羊巠聲。

Abbreviated form of 膳 (meals; provisions) + the top element as described in 盜 (drool with desire) → (figuratively/actually) drool with desire for food (compare 涎) → *covet*; *yearn for* → *envy*. *Be left over* and *remainder* are borrowed meanings.
貪欲也。从㳄，从羑省。羑呼之羑，文王所拘羑里。
As per 我# (bladed weapon) + 羊 sheep → use a bladed weapon to sacrifice a sheep in a ceremony → *honor*; *justice*; *meaning*.
己之威儀也。從我、羊。
夏羊牡曰羭。从羊俞聲。
As per 曷# (cut off) + 羊 sheep → *castrated ram*. Also, the name of a *nomadic tribe* of northwest China.
羊羖犗也。从羊曷聲。
气也。从兮義聲。
黃腹羊。从羊番聲。
羊臭也。从三羊。凡羴之屬皆从羴。
As per 亶# (long and flat) + 羊 sheep → long, flat piece of *rank-smelling mutton/meat* → *rank/foul smelling*.
瘦也。从羊𣎆聲。
羊相厠也。从羴在尸下。尸，屋也。一曰相出前也。
A depiction of curved wings, raised high → *feather*; *wing*; *plumage*. In dual-element characters, 羽 may also appear in the form seen at the right of 詡, 翩, 翅 etc.
鳥長毛也。象形。凡羽之屬皆从羽。
公# open + 羽 feather/wing → open spaces between the feathers of an aged bird →*old man/elder* (← aged).
頸毛也。从羽公聲。
翼也。从羽支聲。
支 here an abbreviated form# of 肢 limb + 羽 feather/wing → *wing(s)* → *fin*. *Merely* and *solely* are borrowed meanings.
樂舞。執全羽以祀社稷也。从羽犮聲。讀若紱。
An abbreviated form# of 翼 (wings raised high) + 立 stand (for emphasis/clarification) → *birds in flight*, with wings standing high. *Assist* and *help* are borrowed meanings.
飛㒵。从羽立聲。

Variant form of 昱 (bright sunlight), the adoption of 羽 suggesting bright sunlight accompanying the rising sun at daybreak or dawn via the "wings standing high" → rise aspect of 翊 → (the) *next* (day); (the) *following* (day); *tomorrow*.
羽也。从羽令聲。
As per 羽# (curved wings, raised high) + the right-hand element as described in 珍 (fullness) → wings fully separated from a bird's body in flight → *soar*.
高飛也。从羽从㐱。

Originally, 羽 feather/wing + 旦# (long and flat) → bird exerting pressure in flapping its long, flat wings. *Learn* is an extended meaning (← learn by repetition ← repeated action in flapping the wings) → *accustomed*; *custom*; *take lessons*. 旦 was later replaced by 白. In derivative characters, 習 most often appears in the form seen for example in 慴, 摺 or 褶.
數飛也。从羽从白。凡習之屬皆从習。
羽 feather/wing + an abbreviated form of 洋 ocean → *soar*/*glide*/*fly* over ocean waters.
回飛也。从羽羊聲。

As per 合# (press/fit together) + 羽 feather/wing → retracted wings, pressed tightly in covering a bird's body → *put together*; *gather* → *happen* (← putting together or gathering regarded as an occurrence).
起也。从羽合聲。
As per 攸# (slender and curved) + 羽 feather/wing → slender, curved trail described by a flock of birds flying in an arc (compare 讎 and 雕) → *rapid flight*. Compare 鷂.
捷也。飛之疾也。从羽夾聲。讀若瀒。一曰俠也。
隹 here a variant form# of 鳥 bird + 羽 feather/wing → long, feathered tail of a *pheasant* rising high in the air.
山雉尾長者。从羽从隹。
As per 卒# (compact) + 羽 feather/wing → (female) *kingfisher* (← compact bird of *green* color). Compare 翡.
青羽雀也。出鬱林。从羽卒聲。
非 here an abbreviated form# of 緋 (vivid color) + 羽 feather/wing → (male) common Indian *kingfisher* (← bird with vividly colored feathers).
赤羽雀也。出鬱林。从羽非聲。
棺羽飾也。天子八，諸侯六，大夫四，士二。下垂。从羽妾聲。
飛舉也。从羽者聲。
As per 前# (cut/shear in small increments) + 羽 feather/wing → shears used to cut closely in clipping wings → *clip*; *shave*; *trim*.
羽生也。一曰𠂕羽。从羽前聲。
鳥之彊羽猛者。从羽是聲。
As per 扁# (spread, but remain in contact) + 羽 feather/wing → wings unfolded in flight (compare 蝙) → *flutter*; *waft*.
疾飛也。从羽扁聲。
As per 元# (round) + 習 learn (specifically, learn by repetition) → smooth out the rough edges of an action by repeated practice → *enjoy*; *take pleasure in* (← enjoy obtaining perfection). Compare 玩.
習猒也。从習元聲。《春秋傳》曰：“翫歲而愒日。”
As per 軍# (circularity) + 羽 feather/wing → *pheasant* tracing a circular pattern in flight → *to fly*.
大飛也。从羽軍聲。一曰伊、雒而南，雉五采皆備曰翬。《詩》曰：“如翬斯飛。”
羽莖也。从羽鬲聲。
鳥白肥澤皃。从羽高聲。《詩》云：“白鳥翯翯。”

An abbreviated form# of 乾 (rise high) + 羽 feather/wing → (long, hard) feather raised in being used as a writing implement → *writing brush* → *letter* (← writing produced by such a brush). *Fly high* is via reinterpretation of the constituent elements of the character.
天雞赤羽也。从羽倝聲。《逸周書》曰：“大翰，若翬雉，一名鷐風。周成王時蜀人獻之。”
翱翔也。从羽皐聲。
As per 殹# (contain; cover) + 羽 feather/wing → *fan* (← one large enough to cover the body when waved by an attendant) → *shade*; *cover*; *conceal*.
華蓋也。从羽殹聲。
As per 堯# (arch/rise high) + 羽 feather/wing → *raised tail feathers* of a pheasant → *raise high*. Also, *outstanding* and *stand on tiptoes*.
尾長毛也。从羽堯聲。
As per 皐# variant form of 皋 (high) + 羽 feather/wing → wings rising high → *fly high*.

As per 番# (spread) + 羽 feather/wing → birds spreading and flapping their wings in preparation to take flight → *flutter*; *wave* → *dodge*; *leap up*. Also, *change* (one's mind) and *turn over*. Note a variant form, 飜, which replaces 羽 with 飛 fly.
飛也。从羽番聲。或从飛。
As per 異# (raise) + 羽 feather/wing → pair of wings, raised high → *wing*.
飛聲也。从羽歲聲。《詩》曰：“鳳皇于飛，翽翽其羽。”
小飛也。从羽瞏聲。
翳也。所以舞也。从羽𣪐聲。《詩》曰：“左執翿。”
